p300x2._comment: Calculated QB2 top-performance estimate, not a measurement. Assumes about 3.8B active MoE parameters per token, BFP8 expert weights, BF16 dense weights, ideal four-chip scaling, full bandwidth utilization, and first-token decode included. The approximately 25.2B total parameters affect residency, not per-token compute. Pure roofline is about 17 ms TTFT and 320 T/S/U; the stored target applies a 70% practical derating, yielding about 24 ms TTFT and 224 T/S/U.
Gating point. Measured on the tt-shield benchmarks run 40120766326 (tt-metal b6e3bd3e4a8). Tolerance 0.2.

blackhole_galaxy._comment: Gating point. Measured 2026-10-31 on a Blackhole Galaxy (bh-glx-exp-b03u14, one 32-chip lane engine, data_parallel_size 4 folded into lanes, the catalog entry's serving config incl. the MTP contract vision class with a lone-row K, 128/256/1024-token lane prefill frames and the 256/512/1024 prefill padding policy) at tt-metal arg/gemma4_spec_default 9f8d2ca87ef with the release client construction (vllm bench serve, random dataset, openai-chat: a 128-token prompt is ~144 tokens after the chat template; per-point seed and cache_salt), run galaxy_26b_pad256_x; mean TTFT / 1000 over mean TPOT / output throughput. Previous shield-measured row (2026-10-26, plain lanes entry at eafd079cd3b): ttft 103.5, tput_user 37.04, tput 36.2; the c128 and 2K/8K TTFT are higher on this tree (the batched lane prefill pads the ~144-token prompt to 256 and the lone-row prefill carries the drafter), a tracked follow-up. Tolerance 0.2.
